summary.text: Jyot Singh is the Democratic candidate for the Georgia House of Representatives, District 97, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Republican Yassin Moghazy in a race with no incumbent.
According to Ballotpedia, Singh has worked as a consultant and small business owner and holds a bachelor's degree from Yale University.

paragraphs.text: Jyot Singh earned a high school diploma from the Gwinnett School of Mathematics, Science, and Technology and a bachelor's degree from Yale University.
Ballotpedia lists Singh's career experience as working as a consultant and small business owner.
Singh defeated Jacques Laurent in the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary for District 97, 59.1% to 40.9%.
Singh did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey.
